1.en_consolidated_definition:
Heroine (n.) 

A female given name derived from the Greek word for "hero" or "demigod." In some contexts, it may also refer to a woman who has achieved great distinction or fame.

In Puerto Rican culture, this term can also be used to describe a strong and courageous woman, particularly one who embodies the values of resilience and determination in the face of adversity.
